open_points.subject: A2 rule 3 camera-time conversion
open_points.text: when its conversion to UTC fails, a moment that type cannot hold among them
open_points.question: Exactly which conditions or exceptions count as a failed conversion to UTC, and must every such failure make that camera candidate unusable so the next candidate is tried?
options: Only a UTC result outside the standard datetime range counts.
Any exception while applying the selected offset or time zone and converting to UTC counts.
A closed list of conversion failures and exception types counts.
open_points.default_guess: Treat any value, overflow or time-zone conversion exception as making that camera candidate unusable, then try the next candidate.

open_points.subject: A2 fallback modification time and A7 rule 4
open_points.text: A file's modification time is converted to the same form before it is compared or delivered, dropping any fraction finer than a microsecond toward the earlier instant.
open_points.question: What happens when the file modification instant cannot be converted to the required UTC datetime representation, either while checking a camera time against it or while using it as the final photo moment?
options: The delivery fails with another specified PlacementFailure.
The whole operation is refused with a specified RefusalCode.
Such modification times are excluded by an explicit invariant or validated earlier.
open_points.default_guess: Treat an unrepresentable modification time as UNREADABLE_FILE and create no placement.
